name: lattice-grid-demo-htmx-kanban
description: Lattice Grid with htmx: a Kanban board built from a server-rendered table, moves posted with hx-post, out-of-band card updates and Back.

paragraphs: The server renders a plain of cards inside a data-lattice-kanban element. Lattice Grid turns it into a Kanban board with no mount code on the page: only markup, htmx and the Lattice htmx module.
The board holds 39 cards across three teams (Growth, Platform and Support), in Todo, Doing and Done columns. The page shows five things:
features: Built on load. The server-rendered card table becomes the board. With JavaScript off it is still a readable table.

Move a card. Dragging a card raises a bubbling lattice:kanban-change event with the card id and the columns it left and reached; hx-trigger="lattice:kanban-change" posts it with hx-post, and the server's reply appears…
A refused drop. The transitions option lists the columns each column may reach, so dragging a Todo card straight to Done is refused before anything is posted.
Out of band. "Server reassigns one card" returns one with hx-swap-oob, and only that card changes owner.
Back. Picking a team runs an hx-get; the old board is torn down and a new one is built from the new table. Pressing Back returns the previous cards with the board rebuilt.
